jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed.  We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description
Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs.

The Product Manager, AI & Workflow Transformation, will lead an Agile team supporting Global Corporate Trust (GCT), driving AI-enabled solutions that improve business processes, increase operational efficiency, and enhance stakeholder experiences. This role partners closely with business and technology teams to understand current-state processes, identify future-state opportunities, and deliver scalable product solutions aligned with strategic objectives. Serving as the product expert, this individual will own backlog management, roadmap execution, prioritization, and delivery while ensuring successful adoption of new technologies and AI-driven capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Ownership
- Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for AI-related capabilities supporting GCT.
- Identify opportunities to re-engineer business processes through AI, automation, and workflow optimization.
- Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather feedback, and translate requirements into scalable product solutions.

Agile Product Leadership
- Manage and prioritize the product backlog, including epics, features, and user stories.
- Lead backlog refinement sessions, define acceptance criteria, and ensure alignment across business and technology teams.
- Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and cross-functional partners to manage dependencies and support delivery planning.

AI & Workflow Transformation
- Drive AI-enabled initiatives that enhance productivity, decision-making, and operational effectiveness.
- Partner with technology teams to deliver governed, scalable, and business-aligned AI solutions.
- Support the evaluation and adoption of emerging AI tools, platforms, and capabilities.

Stakeholder & Adoption Leadership
- Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to execute product strategy and communicate priorities, timelines, and outcomes.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing and validate delivered solutions meet business expectations.
- Lead readiness, change management, and adoption activities to ensure successful implementation of new capabilities.

Basic Qualifications:
- Product Management experience.
- Typically, 5-10 years of experience

Preferred Skills & Experience
- Advanced understanding of AI technologies, tools, and models, with the ability to redesign processes leveraging AI capabilities.
- Experience creating or supporting Microsoft Copilot Agents or similar AI agent solutions preferred.
- Advanced knowledge of Agile product development methodologies.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through delivery.
- Ability to understand and translate both technical and non-technical requirements into practical solutions.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Experience within Global Corporate Trust, financial services, or other regulated industries preferred.

Job Description
Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer-obsessed leaders who drive product vision, strategy, planning, and delivery to advance our human + digital product strategy while staying ahead of evolving customer, business, and technology needs.

As a Pricing & Profitability Product Manager, you will play a key role in driving the evolution of platforms and capabilities that support loan pricing, profitability analysis, commercial banking decision-making, and related sales enablement processes. This role sits within the Sales, Credit and Servicing Center of Excellence (COE), a full-service technology implementation organization responsible for product design, delivery, and modernization across several strategic financial services platforms.

The COE supports solutions including Salesforce, PrecisionLender, Zafin, Curinos, and nCino, which enable critical capabilities across customer relationship management, lending, pricing and profitability, product onboarding, and commercial banking operations. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, testing organizations, release management teams, and external vendors, you will help deliver innovative solutions that improve the employee and customer experience, increase market competitiveness, drive growth and manage risk.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with the ability to quickly learn complex financial services products, pricing and profitability concepts, and enterprise technology platforms. Success in this role requires curiosity, adaptability, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate customer and business needs into scalable product solutions.

- Operate effectively in ambiguous environments while balancing multiple priorities and competing stakeholder needs.
- Build broad cross-functional product knowledge and contribute across multiple product domains as business priorities evolve

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience.
- Typically eight or more years of experience in product management, business analysis, technology delivery, data and analytics, or related disciplines.

Digital Product Managers at U. S. Bank are customer obsessed in defining and delivering the strategy and vision required for digital experiences to stay ahead of constantly evolving economic, competitive, technological, and customer needs.
This Senior Digital Product Manager will report to the head of Corporate Digital Servicing. This role will be responsible for contributing to the development and evolution of U.S. Bank’s long-term digital strategy for corporate and commercial customer lifecycle management. This leader will focus on researching, ideating, prioritizing, promoting, and delivering digital capabilities and automation to strengthen our ability to acquire, retain and service corporate clients. Additionally, this leader will regularly interact with stakeholders across the bank to discuss opportunities, strategic vision, roadmap prioritization, risks, and more.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Emerging Capabilities & Future Platforms
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed.  We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Job Description
The AI Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior AI Product Manager to help shape the bank's future AI capabilities beyond the current planning horizon. This role operates at the intersection of emerging technology, product strategy, platform evolution, and business transformation.

Unlike traditional product management roles focused on near-term delivery, this position is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and informing future AI opportunities, technologies, and partnerships that could materially impact the bank over the next several years. The individual will work closely with AI Strategy, AI Platform Product Management, Architecture, and senior leadership to understand where the industry is heading and translate those insights into actionable recommendations for the enterprise.

This role requires intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a strong ability to navigate ambiguity. Success is measured less by the volume of initiatives launched and more by the quality of strategic recommendations, insights generated, and future opportunities uncovered.

Key Responsibilities
Shape the Future AI Roadmap
- Identify emerging AI capabilities, technology trends, and market developments that may influence the bank's long-term AI strategy.

- Develop and maintain a forward-looking view of AI technologies, vendors, and industry solutions that extend beyond current delivery priorities.

- Partner with AI Strategy and AI Platform Product Management to ensure future opportunities align to the bank's evolving AI vision and platform direction.

- Evaluate where external capabilities may accelerate or complement internal investments.

Scout and Assess Emerging Solutions
- Continuously monitor the AI ecosystem, including startups, established technology providers, academic research, and emerging market trends.

- Conduct strategic evaluations of vendors and platforms, assessing their applicability, maturity, risks, and alignment with future business needs.

- Build comparative assessments and recommendation frameworks to support executive decision-making.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on emerging technologies and competitive developments.

Explore, Experiment, and Learn
- Conduct lightweight discovery efforts, proofs of concept, and exploratory prototyping to validate strategic ideas and technology opportunities.

- Utilize modern AI tools and platforms to rapidly assess capabilities and understand technical feasibility.

- Distill complex technical concepts into business implications and strategic choices.

- Pursue opportunities that may have uncertain outcomes while maintaining disciplined evaluation criteria.

Inform Executive Decision-Making
- Synthesize market intelligence, technology assessments, and experimentation results into concise recommendations for senior leaders.

- Highlight strategic tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and considerations associated with future investments.

- Influence roadmap discussions through evidence-based insights rather than formal authority.

- Help leadership navigate significant technology decisions in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

This role is best suited for a product leader who enjoys exploring emerging technologies, evaluating future possibilities, and influencing strategy through insight and expertise. It is not primarily a people management or large-scale delivery execution role

Basic Qualifications
- Digital Product Management experience

Preferred Skills/Experience
Strategic Thinking
- Demonstrated ability to think beyond immediate delivery horizons and anticipate future technology needs.

- Strong understanding of AI market dynamics, emerging technologies, and industry trends.

- Experience developing product strategy, technology evaluations, or innovation roadmaps.

Technical Aptitude
- Working knowledge of modern AI technologies, including foundation models, AI platforms, agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, and related tooling.

Job Description
Person in this role will bring to the Operations Data Products & Governance team Data as a Product in service to Governance as a Service mindset. This role supports our Data Product Owners through backlog refinement, data pipeline change testing, and efforts supporting our quality, cataloging & lineage organizations. You will support operations through business metrics-based Requirements Gathering, Data Product development & implementation, and supporting the orchestration of Data Engineering, Quality, Linage, Catalogues and Architecture teams across Operations & Technology. Candidate partners across Operations within a Shared Services organization supporting Lines of Business, Risk/Compliance professionals, technology, and business line leaders to deploy data products and maintain data governance practices as it relates to data, analytics and reporting.

Responsibilities:
- Partners with Product Owners to manage the Data Product(s)

- Gathers data requirements from Clients & Consumers for Data Products

- Supports Refinement, Product Management, and day-to-day Stand-ups

- Assesses the needs of Business Metrics Lineage & coordinates new lineage needs

- Refines & Deploys data assets which align with Data Governance standards

- Leads Agile ways of Working / Scrum Team Rituals

Requirements:
- Agile / Waterfall development practices, Product Management / Product Owner, Data Catalogs, Databricks, Snowflake, Data Quality, Structured Query Language (SQL), Data Analytics (Power BI, Tableau, Python, Alteryx (a plus))

- Familiarity with Databricks or Snowflake architecture, including data cataloging, lineage, access and integration with governance tools like Unity Catalog / Collibra

- Deployed Cloud (Azure, AWS) Data Platform Solutions on behalf of Organization, serving Enterprise marketplace

- Explored A.I. acceleration through the use of tools and/or agents
